note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation 5 list (Exophase / PSNProfiles). Every guide is written in this entry's own words and names its source. Four trophies had no confirmed method at release and say so honestly instead of inventing one.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This one unlocks itself once the other 54 are done. It needs single-player only — no multiplayer and no DLC trophies stand between you and it. Work the roadmap in order and it pops at the very end.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. Finish the first mission of Chapter 1, Gone Fishing, and it unlocks the moment the mission ends.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Play through Chapter 1 to its end; it pops once you start Chapter 2 with the mission What's in the Bag?

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Clear Chapter 2; it unlocks as Chapter 3 opens with Welcome to Vice City.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Clear Chapter 3; it pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Clear Chapter 4 by finishing its last mission, Starting From Zero.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The gold story trophy. Finish the final mission — the same Chapter 4 mission, Starting From Zero — and the credits roll with this one.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy from Chapter 2. Play the mission Breakfast Run to its end; it unlocks automatically.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy from Chapter 3. Complete the mission The Cartel Heist.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy from Chapter 4. Complete the mission Child's Play.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy from Chapter 4. Complete the mission Headliners.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy from Chapter 4. Complete the mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy from Chapter 5. Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The big one: reach 100% Completion, checked at Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — the list only appears after the story, but progress made during the story already counts. The bar is kinder than it sounds, about 60% true completion: any 100 optional missions (there are 200 to 300 or more), 200 of 277 base vehicle models scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 300 stunts, any 70 of 80 challenges, plus every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest. Nothing in it is missable, so clean it up in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land any 250 of the 397 stunts; the 100% checklist wants 300. The four kinds are 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights and 25 Base Jumps — mix them, and fly under bridges for the fastest count. Track them at Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, or find named spots under Map, then Exploration, then Stunt Spots.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: Fishing, Hunting, Golf, Shooting Ranges, Pool, Basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check what is left at Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities; most of them happen on their own while you chase the other trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every one of the 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 range locations. Gold medals here are not punishing, and the ranges also feed your Focus level, so work them in a batch.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at each of the 14 locations — 42 races in all, three per spot. You only need one win per location, so skip the races that give you trouble and come back for the 100% checklist later.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations, so pick the formats you are best at and rotate; every win at a new location counts.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal), Cal texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple icon. Follow his fishing questline to its end and beat him in the fishing challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game all the way through — every level, once. Three games (Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind) play on the TV at home from Chapter 1; the fourth, Bang For Your Buck, sits in arcade machines around the map. Pick whichever you like best; challenge modes are not required.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Lucia only. In Chapter 3, Andy calls, then texts her address in Belville, opening a five-quest chain: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (Join the Cellerica Initiation), Read the Label (Retrieve the Cellerica Van), and Puff Puff Pass (Meet at the Warehouse). Finish the last one; the chain stays available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Island Dreams (Work for Kenton), Kenton calls and is marked with a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — use the metal detector on the ocean floor — and each returned set brings a new call with more wrecks. Track it at Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees, or Collections, then Kenton's Treasures. He goes quiet between Chapters 1 and 2 to 3 and comes back, so nothing here is missable.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, Billy's chain opens at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Five quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler (Steal the Impaler), and Hometown Heroes. Finish the last one; the chain stays open after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands. Only some strangers count: Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunts — Skunk Apeology 101, tree effigies, Advanced Skunk Apeonomics), Kyle (McKittrick Farm, the chemicals, Buddy?), Yago (street race, mentoring, racing and backing him up), and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile twice, plus his deliveries). Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count — they have their own trophies or none. More strangers may still be undiscovered, and all of it can be done after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy), Randy hands you a wish list of 16 sports cars — the Zorrusso is already delivered by the mission itself. Steal the rest (Vitello, Infernus, Windsor Drop, Toros, Tempesta, Paragon, Jagular, Jubilee, Itali RSX, Growler, Gauntlet Hellfire, Furia, Dubsta, Banshee, Baller ST-D) and drive each to the green RK marker west of Vice City; a car in good shape pays more. Track the list at Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List, and scan cars with the WAiNK app to check whether one is wanted.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason only. After the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs around Vice City. Smash the labs in the Take Out Kitty Litter quests, and Tyrone then offers Spin On This (Shut Down the Labs) — finish it for the trophy. All of it survives the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 spots at 10 locations, tracked at Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. Doing a spot with both Jason and Lucia counts double (+2). POTENTIALLY MISSABLE: one meditation happens only in Chapter 1, at Jason's home. After the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony when she talks about meditating, and choose Accept. It is not yet proven whether that one is required for the trophy — the 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18 — but do it while you can, because it never comes back.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Jason only. After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, Bret Vogel texts you and marks Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret) in Lummox County. His chain is a hunting list: he marks targets on the map, you bring the animals back. The first quest hands you the unique rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker. There are 15 Target Decks in total and all 15 feed the 100% checklist; which exact animal pops the trophy is still being pinned down.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 set locations around Leonida; finish any three full sets and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1). The world holds more than 100: 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures, plus other scannable spots. Any 100 count, so scan as you travel instead of hunting a fixed list.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish any 50 of the 80 challenges, tracked at Progress, then Challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70, so this one arrives on the way — pick the easiest 50 first and leave the hardest 10 untouched.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then get clear of the red heat zone. You can free-roam as a pair after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break (call your partner with hold Right + Triangle). Build four stars however you like, then break away on a fast sports bike — the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a reliable escape, since the helicopter loses you on the tracks. It also pops on its own during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe), because the bank vault job throws a 4-star wanted level at you.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level. Available after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. Keep the flashing red/blue wanted level — never let it settle into the solid red heat zone — and work through three shops in a row. Pack an armored vest and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation plus Zombix or Adrenaline for healing. The three jewelry stores north of Vice City work well once Chapter 3's Yasmani jewelry jobs are open; if it does not pop after the third shop, hit a fourth. The unlock can lag about 30 seconds after you leave the third shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1). The game ships with 557 vehicles; the fastest way is to stand on a busy street and scan whatever drives past. Track it at Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles. The 100% checklist needs 200 base models scanned, so keep scanning as you play.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies inside a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3+R3 while aiming; the purple focus bar shows your window. Set it up where enemies bunch together, such as Gang Operations, and use the Duke 556 rifle. Raise your Focus level first (shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing, headshots) and top it up with food, drink, a wash, or Adrenaline (hold L1, then Triangle). It does not count against soldiers, police or civilians.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a big passenger plane that is docked at a terminal at VCIA — one with a boarding bridge attached — not a plane parked out on the field. Gates E3/E4 are the easiest. Climb to the cockpit on the upper deck, reverse onto the runway, take off, and fly about 1 km clear of the airport.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank from Mile Zero Air Station, on the island in the south-west of the map in Mariana County. The tanks sit at the south end of the base — grab one and get out before the base wakes up.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. This opens after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun and jewelry robberies. Slip in through the back door, pick locks silently with the Snap Gun, and look for the safe code note in the back room. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. It starts with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe): tail the security van to the bank, the guard opens the vault, and you carry the bags out with your partner (hold Right to hand over the bag). After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips (purple icon; you need his earlier quests, including robbing 2 Payday Loans). Every vault job throws a 4-star wanted level at once, so escape on a fast bike and swap cars. There are 8 big bank jobs in total and all 8 feed the 100% checklist, paying up to $205,000 per bank.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The easiest route is the Chapter 4 mission that also counts for Maximum Withdrawal — a big bank vault robbery counts as an armored truck job. Earlier, you can ambush a truck near a bank in Vice City, blow its rear doors with a sticky bomb, and clear the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are sold behind Yasmani's shop once his quests are done.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida and lift the fog from the whole map — 52 areas in total. The quickest way is by plane: fly over every patch of black fog and it clears beneath you.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — one per gang is enough for the trophy, though the 100% checklist wants all 39. Operations show as yellow icons when you get close, and you can track each gang at Progress, then Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: NOT YET CONFIRMED — no reliable method was known when this guide was written. The description points at a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, but no source has confirmed the exact spot or trigger yet. Do not trust a method you read without a source; this entry will be updated when one is confirmed.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (still lists it as currently unknown)

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: CONFIRMED. Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight out through the showroom window. You can only take the car after unlocking the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy): hack into the Banshee, drive forward through the glass, and keep driving — the trophy pops a little late, once you are further down the street. Only that specific blue Banshee counts, not any other car. It is a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal the 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, a gang operation. Buy sticky bombs at Ammu-Nation first — you need them for the safe. The three items: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office, blown open with a sticky bomb. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item. It opens during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling; if you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns after a while, so it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check it at Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, then Strength (heart icon). Available after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Train together — call your partner with hold Right + Triangle — because while one of you works out, the other gains progress too. Buy a fitness club membership and find clubs under Map, then Activities (dumbbell icon).

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that move your criminal profile; the count shows when you click the trophy in the list. Turn on notifications at Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile = On, and a small demon face appears at the right of the screen for each counted action. Profiles run from Professional (clean stealth and escapes) through Hardened (incapacitate without killing), Violent, and Psycho, to Irredeemable — which is permanent, so do not push violence that far. Most of it happens passively during robberies and fights; if you are short at the end, farm it by running over civilians and police with a car.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: NOT YET CONFIRMED — no reliable method was known when this guide was written. The description reads 'Second time's the charm', and PowerPyx notes a guess that it may involve the Payday Loans store from the prologue — but that is only a guess, not a confirmed method. Treat any walkthrough that states it as fact with suspicion until a source confirms it.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (still lists it as currently unknown)

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: NOT YET CONFIRMED — no reliable method was known when this guide was written. The description reads 'What the hell just happened?', and PowerPyx notes a guess that it may come from a UFO questline — but that is only a guess, not a confirmed method.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (still lists it as currently unknown)

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: NOT YET CONFIRMED — no reliable method was known when this guide was written. The description points at bowling someone over with a melee drive-by, and PowerPyx notes a guess that it may involve kicking enemies while riding a motorcycle — but that is only a guess, not a confirmed method.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (still lists it as currently unknown)

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative, not in one trip, and bank vaults pay up to $205,000 each.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The fastest route is the expensive stuff: guns, car mods and tattoos. The map holds 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair & beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garage properties (the 4 story garages do not count), $160,000 in total. They open for sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app lands on your phone — buy them through the app.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app, which arrives on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). Buy garages first — each one adds parking slots — then drive stolen cars to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray + Register in his garage. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3, cars with standard trackers can be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes.
